blocks.prompt: 11. Find the general solution of the differential equation \((e^{2x} + e^{-2x})\,dy + (e^{-2x} - e^{2x})\,dx = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Dono brackets mein sirf \(x\) hai; \(y\) sirf \(dy\) ki shakal mein aaya hai. Is liye separable: \(dy = f(x)\,dx\).
Find kya karna hai? General solution.
Rule kaunsa? Agar upar wala neeche wale ki derivative (ya us ka hissa) ho to integral log hota hai.
Plan: \(dy\) ko akela karenge, neeche wale ki derivative nikal kar dekhenge ke upar us ka aadha hai, phir integrate.
steps:
Diya gaya: \((e^{2x} + e^{-2x})\,dy + (e^{-2x} - e^{2x})\,dx = 0\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Separable hai. \(dy = f(x)\,dx\) likh kar \(\int\frac{f'}{f} = \ln|f|\) wala rule lagayenge.

Alag karein
\[dy = \dfrac{e^{2x} - e^{-2x}}{e^{2x} + e^{-2x}}\,dx\]
Kyun: \(dx\) wali term ko right par bheja to us ke bracket ka sign badal gaya: \(-(e^{-2x} - e^{2x}) = e^{2x} - e^{-2x}\). Phir \(e^{2x} + e^{-2x}\) se divide kiya.
Dhyan dein: Yahi sign badalna sab se aham hai; ghalat sign se jawab mein minus aa jata hai.

Neeche wale ki derivative dekhein
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(e^{2x} + e^{-2x}) = 2e^{2x} - 2e^{-2x}\]
\[= 2(e^{2x} - e^{-2x})\]
Kyun: Chain rule: \(e^{kx}\) ki derivative \(ke^{kx}\). \(e^{-2x}\) ki derivative \(-2e^{-2x}\). Dekhiye, hamara numerator is derivative ka bilkul aadha hai.

Integrate karein
\[y = \dfrac{1}{2}\ln(e^{2x} + e^{-2x}) + \dfrac{1}{2}\ln|C|\]
Kyun: \(\int\frac{f'}{f} = \ln|f|\), aur numerator aadha tha is liye \(\frac{1}{2}\) aaya. \(e^{2x} + e^{-2x}\) hamesha positive hai. Constant ko \(\frac{1}{2}\ln|C|\) likha taake agla qadam aasaan ho.

Saaf karein
\[2y = \ln|C(e^{2x} + e^{-2x})|\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 2 se multiply kiya, phir \(\ln a + \ln b = \ln ab\) se dono logs jore. Kitab ka jawab bhi yahi hai.

Tasdeeq
\(y = \frac{1}{2}\ln(e^{2x} + e^{-2x}) + \text{const}\) se:
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot \dfrac{2e^{2x} - 2e^{-2x}}{e^{2x} + e^{-2x}}\]
\[= \dfrac{e^{2x} - e^{-2x}}{e^{2x} + e^{-2x}}\]
Kyun: Log ki derivative \(\frac{f'}{f}\); 2 cancel ho gaya aur alag ki hui equation wapas mil gayi.
